_doc: Hand-labelled precision@5 ground truth for tests/test_retrieval_regression.py. Every expect_* id is a real node in graph_v5_snapshot.json (verified in-suite by test_ground_truth_ids_are_real_nodes). 'gap: true' marks a case whose expected note shares the route seed's community (ai_distraction_filter) AND is not reachable within 2 hops of ANY route seed over wikilink/mentions/skill-link edges, so ONLY the v5 community-seeded expansion in related_nodes() can surface it in the top 5. Both gap cases are seeded solely on 'difficulty_dial' because it is the one snapshot node whose 2-hop retrieval closure excludes a high-centrality note-layer community-mate (see task-6-report.md). The two non-gap cases that also label note:Focus-Command-Center (constellation builder / gamification summary) are real v5 improvements too, but there the note IS 2-hop reachable, so the win is bonus reordering / crowd-out recovery, not an edge-less gap -- they are left untagged on purpose.
